copy: Media drill-ins — stock browser · icon picker · versions · used-in · image editor
Icons are inlined as SVG at publish, so they take the current text colour.
Replacing an asset updates every page using it — that is what Used-in is for.
Deleting this breaks 3 pages. Replace it instead.
